identitySignals: Leadership Public Schools' own site lists 'LPS Oakland R&D' as one of its three campuses, matching the agenda name 'Leadership Public School Oakland R&D' (leadps.org)
Registered Oakland, CA nonprofit 'Leadership Public Schools Inc', EIN 73-1643646, 501(c)(3) that operates a school (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)

The campus is a public charter high school at 8601 MacArthur Blvd, Oakland, consistent with an OUSD Measure N/H (high school college and career readiness) MOU and a 'Classroom & academic programs' contract
research.notes: The agenda names the Oakland R&D campus; the contracting entity is presumably its operator, Leadership Public Schools Inc (same network, same EIN), whose phone/email/address are the network's main contact details, not the campus's (campus phone on its page is different). No explicit OUSD or Measure N mention was found on the organization's pages. California SOS entity number and SAM UEI not checked/found.

profile.summary: Leadership Public Schools is a nonprofit that runs a network of three charter high schools in the Bay Area, in Hayward, Oakland and Richmond. The Oakland R&D campus is a free public charter high school that prepares students for college, career and community leadership.

sources.title: Leadership Public Schools Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: leadps.org lists LPS Oakland R&D as one of its three charter high schools and ProPublica shows Leadership Public Schools Inc (EIN 73-1643646, Oakland, 501(c)(3), operates a school), so the operator is the same organization OUSD's Measure N/H school-program MOU would involve. The summary and the network-level contact fields (phone, email, 99 Linden St address) match the cited pages, and the summary is neutral.
